mapper.select: select a.*, u.nick_name reviewer_name from research_acceptance a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.reviewer_id where a.project_id = #{projectId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into research_acceptance( project_id, project_summary, completion_statement, unfinished_items, acceptance_note, status, submitted_at, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values( #{projectId}, #{projectSummary}, #{completionStatement}, #{unfinishedItems}, #{acceptanceNote}, #{status}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update research_acceptance set project_summary = #{projectSummary}, completion_statement = #{completionStatement}, unfinished_items = #{unfinishedItems}, acceptance_note = #{acceptanceNote}, reviewer_id = null, review_comment = null, status = #{status}, submitted_at = sysdate(), reviewed_at = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}

update research_acceptance set reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, status = #{status}, reviewed_at = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}
